IIT Bombay Report Suggests UPI MDR Fee Cut, Examines Customer Impact

An IIT Bombay study has proposed reducing the UPI Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) from 0.4% to 0.08%. The study also identified two consequences of merchants passing on MDR costs to customers: purchases exceeding ₹2,000 incur higher prices, and these increased prices extend to purchases below ₹2,000.
